issue_request: FHIR-47469 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by FHIR-I to add an optional async-bulk output file item field, `filesize`, representing the file size in bytes as a JSON number alongside the optional `count` field.
initial_application: HL7/fhir pull request #3215 applied the issue: commit 7ab6c58528ff709d8a090d7a6b77e563e7a94385 added the `filesize` bullet to `source/async-bulk.html`, and merge commit 90846c660edeba796d95abdfa67ecda59a62622e merged that change into core.
additional_context: Later R6 normative work in commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd deleted `source/async-bulk.html` and `source/async-bundle.html` from core and changed `source/async.html` to point readers to the API Incubator while the details are finalized through implementation testing. The external HL7/api-incubator-ig source file `input/pagecontent/async-bulk.html` contains the FHIR-47469 `filesize` bullet. The current API Incubator publication/link state appears to need separate follow-up, but that work is outside this core-source reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Restoring the old core page or duplicating the field in `source/async.html` would conflict with the current source-scope decision to keep detailed async-bulk content in the API Incubator.
